title: trqp: non-URI request type echoed into typeUri
description: git-vouch-trqp error_document copies any non-empty request type into payload.inResponseTo.typeUri, which trust-task-error/0.5 payload.schema.json:50 declares format uri. Found once vouch-s9w2.13 turned on format checking (rfc3986-validator). Reproduced: POST a valid request with type 'not a uri' -> unsupportedType reply; the schema oracle raises ValidationError: 'not a uri' is not a 'uri'. The envelope schema also requires type to be a uri, so such a request is arguably malformedRequest. Fix options: refuse a type that is not an absolute URI as malformedRequest before the unsupportedType test, or omit inResponseTo when the type is not a URI. Test: add with_doc(type='not a uri') to test_refused_documents; Bridge.post schema-checks the reply.
